Class ServerController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.server.ServerController
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable
public class ServerController extends Object implements Runnable
Server-side controller that validates player actions, updates the match state, and broadcasts snapshots to connected clients.
